sources.title: Essential Energy DAPR and zone-substation capacity data 2025
known_gaps: Zone-substation summer/winter capacity and five-year forecasts are reconciled for all 366 published zone-substation records.
Bulk supply point, sub-transmission line, limitation, retirement/derating and augmentation tables remain separate follow-on ingestion tasks.
Substation coordinates/geometry remain to be joined from the Essential Energy DAPR portal before map rendering.
Arithmetic firm-capacity margin is not guaranteed connection headroom and must not be presented as such.

datasets.provenance: Essential Energy DAPR 2025 BSP, ZS and Lines Extract Summary V2 workbook; exhaustive matched ZSSummer/ZSWinter zone-substation inventory
datasets.selection_policy: Include every published zone-substation identity present in both ZSSummer and ZSWinter and preserve source summer/winter transformer, firm-rating, forecast, embedded-generation and peak-duration fields.
datasets.completeness_test: Independent openpyxl identity inventory and separate stdlib/XML extraction must reconcile exactly with identical summer/winter identity sets and zero missing/extra/duplicate assets.
